<b>Passing of the Age</b> is a [[Unique Wishes|Unique Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by examining a [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Putrified Ducts|Lore Tablet]] in the [[Putrified Ducts]]. This Lore Tablet reveals the 7 locations of [[Mister Mushroom (Silksong)|Mister Mushroom]], which [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must visit in order.

== Starting Location ==
The Wish is given by a [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Putrified Ducts|Lore Tablet]] in the [[Putrified Ducts]], which is accessible using [[Silk Soar]]. It is above and to the right of the [[Pale Lake]]/[[Fleatopia]]. This Lore Tablet is disabled in [[Act 2]] and cannot be read until [[Act 3]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Mister Mushroom Lore Tablet.png!The Lore Tablet's location in the Putrified Ducts.
| Image2 = Screenshot SS Mister Mushroom Lore Tablet.png!The Lore Tablet.
}}

Upon reading the tablet, Hornet speaks: 

{{HTalk|So, the Herald visits this land too...}} <br>
{{HTalk|If he is here, now, then great change or a savage end is inevitable. He would care to see nothing else...}}

== Riddle Tablet ==
The seven locations of Mister Mushroom are hinted at on the Lore Tablet, although they are a bit cryptic.

* <i>We speak the wish of the Master Herald, he who signs an Age's end.</i>
* <i>Under chapel fallen to the monarch's might,</i> (Just below the [[Ruined Chapel]])
* <i>Over camp collapsed to the black thread plight,</i> (Above the ruins of [[Bone Bottom]])
* <i>Scorched field on edge, shells black and burned,</i> (The eastern edge of [[Far Fields]])
* <i>Up towers spinning, near the surgeon spurned,</i> ([[Greymoor]], below [[Wisp Thicket]])
* <i>Cage of one who raged against the silken lie,</i> ([[The Slab]], outside of the [[First Sinner]] arena)
* <i>Fell heart of frost, who soars on high,</i> ([[Mount Fay]], where the [[Faydown Cloak]] was obtained)
* <i>Past cradle's peak, last test of fitness,</i> (Right below [[Nameless Town]], in the [[Border Caves]] above [[The Cradle]])
* <i>That the age may pass, this shroom its witness.</i>

| Image1 = Mapshot SS Moss Mother 01.png!Location in Ruined Chapel

| Image3 = Mapshot SS Mister Mushroom 01.png!Location in Far Fields
| Image4 = Mapshot SS Mister Mushroom 02.png!Location in Greymoor

| Image6 = Mapshot SS Fayforn.png!Location in Mount Fay

At each of the first six locations, playing the [[Needolin]] summons Mister Mushroom from the ground, except for the [[Mount Fay]] location, where he appears to be talking directly to the [[Fayforn]]. After attempting to talk to him and listening to his enigmatic dialogue, he goes back underground and can be found in the next location.

== Final Location ==
At the final location below the [[Nameless Town]], Mister Mushroom talks directly to Hornet after being summoned, and then ascends into the sky.

After the game is subsequently completed, there is a [[Endings (Silksong)#Extra Ending: Passing of the Age|special cutscene]] following the normal ending cutscene.

== Achievements ==
{{Achievement|game=silksong|Passing of the Age}}

== Trivia ==
* The icon for the Wish resembles the [[Spore Shroom]] charm from <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.
* The Riddle Tablet's text is the only [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)|Lore Tablet]] in the game to take up the full screen.
